text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: When I came to Hokkaido before, I was honestly in terrible shape. During the Hanshin Daishoten, my right shoulder hurt and I couldn’t race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Then in the Takarazuka Kinen after that... I couldn’t make it. Not at all. I was seriously in awful condition and completely fed up. But then—

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Whoooaa!! Tosen Jordaaaan!! Show us the strength you had when you won in Hakodate!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —They were so warm. They still had expectations for me. For someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Even though I was thinking about running away, thinking there’s no way I could do it... they believed in me more than I did myself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —That’s why... I could finally believe in myself too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I owe them. So much. So... this is a good chance, right? To tell everyone in Hokkaido—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —I have to tell them. Without running away. Properly...!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!! Amazing...!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (Even if the performance changes, what I have to do here doesn’t. I’ll reach out. Toward the light. —Never give up, no matter how many times.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, how was it? Pretty cool, right? Me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —It’s all thanks to everyone! Because of you, I could become this me!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Whoooaa!! Tosen Jordaaaan!! Thanks for coming back to see us again!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. Saying thanks, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That’s my line.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That concludes today’s performance! We look forward to seeing you again~!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: It was amazing! Thank you!! Come again, we’ll be waiting!!

text_block_list.name: Audience C
text_block_list.text: I thought I’d never get to see the Sacred Hoof Festival live... but you came! I’m so happy!!! Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Aha. Ahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I’m really glad we did it.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Alright then, ready? One, two—Maaaarvelooouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Maaaarvelooouuus♪ M-Maaaarvelous...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha☆ Food time! I’m starving—Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on. Did everyone eat the hot pot? Isn’t it insane? Like, totally Bono-level good?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ It’s Ishikari-nabe made with Hokkaido salmon~! There’s plenty, so have as much as you like~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...You know what? That was a total success, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah♪ The guests all had such Bono smiles... ehehe. I couldn’t help but smile too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu. You’re right. Especially that sea of lights— I never imagined it. It just made my chest burn with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha☆ I’m sure we properly passed on our Marvelous! That’s why they returned it to us! The most wonderful Marvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes, I believe we achieved the best—no, an even better—result than we could have hoped for. Once again, great work everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Great job~. Let’s work hard on cleanup next.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Akebono~! The bus is leaving! Let’s go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah... okay! I’m coming~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The tent’s gone now, huh. In just one day. Feels kind of lonely.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It does feel lonely.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That’s why... let’s start again☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: We’ve only done one local show so far! That’s nowhere near enough! We have to spread even more Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Not just Japan, the whole world too! Because the circus is meant to travel everywhere! So—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey, where should we go next?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah~! Where should we go next? Maybe further south? There’s lots of Bono-delicious stuff in Kyushu too! I can’t wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry Akebono! Wait just a sec! There’s something I have to say!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Next time, we’ll definitely come to your town too! Aha☆ Bye-b—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —See you again! Maaaarveloooous☆★☆
